gitCommit.subject: README: the control website of Dukan ERP, developed and operated by TSX-MR
gitCommit.body:
README: the control website of Dukan ERP, developed and operated by TSX-MR

The last "Electronics Retail Management System" in this repository. The
site already names Dukan ERP everywhere; it links to no app store and opens
no app link, so the app's new identifiers (dukanerp, mr.tsxmr.dukanerp)
need nothing here.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
